config.pore_pressure_definition: u_kPa = ru * gamma_kN_m3 * vertical_slice_height_m; imposed ratio, not rainfall or a seepage solution

material.label: Literature-inspired WD-1 illustrative material; not Rock3D site calibration
material.source: Arrieta & Zhang 2024, WD-1, sections 3.3 / 3.7-3.10, tables 6-8. S/UCS is a quoted illustrative ratio, no continuous D50-to-S curve inferred. Synthetic PSD has specified mass median, shape is assumed.

limitations: No interslice shear in simplified Bishop
Circular finite search domain only, not global optimum
No field calibration, seepage, displacement, dynamic or 3D stability model
Mass PSD is synthetic, not formal Rock3D PSD
FoS values are simulation outputs, not site acceptance or safety certification
